device_label: PhC cavity Michelson IQ modulator (two cavities, 40 x 200 um^2)
modulation_format: 4-QAM (2 bits/symbol) from two binary-driven cavities, 2^7-1 PRBS, 20 MHz to 1 GHz modulation frequency, EVM below 0.27 (average over symbols) up to near the 3 dB cutoff
driver: 12.5 GHz pulse pattern generator (quarter-rate outputs) via bias tees and RF probes; DC bias 4.4 V and -4.15 V
notes: One physical device. No Vpi (resonant device, tuning efficiency instead). Per-cavity fit (Table I p.4, fitted to Fig. 3b,c and 4b): Q 6.6e4 / 7.4e4, total linewidth 2.9 / 2.6 GHz (cavity 1 / 2), kappa_c/kappa_i 0.46 / 1.42, tuning 1.15 / 1.09 GHz/V; first-order perturbation theory gives 1.0 GHz/V (p.3, Supp VI). Row tuning 0.0092 nm/V is the cavity-1 slope read from Fig. 3b (cavity 2: 8.7 pm/V, Fig. 3c); q_loaded 70000 is the paper approximate value (text p.2). 3 dB cutoff around 1.5 GHz for each cavity (Fig. 4a, small-signal, plotted 0 to 5 GHz, matches the fitted linewidths); reference entered as dc (curve normalised at 0 GHz, not stated by the authors). ER: more than 30 dB at the two destructive-interference minima of |t_IQ|^2 (Fig. 4b inset, p.3), static. 4-QAM drive: +-1 V on each cavity (2 V peak to peak, p.2; p.3); no baud rate stated (the modulation frequency 1 GHz is not identified as a symbol rate), so max_baud and line rate left empty. Energy 25.8 fJ/bit = 51.5 fJ/symbol / 2 bits from a COMSOL Maxwell capacitance matrix (C11 10.6, C12 9.4, C22 22.2 fF) and a 0D circuit simulation with 0-2 V swing (Supp VI p.19), an author estimate. Geometry: 600 nm film, 400 nm etch (slab 200 nm derived), 35 deg outer sidewall and about 17 deg inner sidewall in the Bragg gaps (p.6), waveguide 800 nm tapering to 900 nm in the PhC, Bragg period 426 nm, 660 nm directional-coupler gap, 12:88 measured splitting ratio at 1548.65 nm (Supp Fig. 3, p.14). Electrode gap not stated in text. Facet insertion loss 8.2 dB (15 percent transmission, faulty facet etch; about 3 dB in other runs) in Supp IX p.26 is not entered because the paper does not define it as on-chip or fiber-to-fiber loss. Fabrication yield 64 percent: 18 of 28 resonant two-sided cavities (of 51 measured) with Q above 2e4 (Supp Fig. 11, p.18). Coherent receiver (AIM Photonics silicon PIC) limited detection to 2 GHz. Sidewall angle 35 deg is measured from the chip normal as stated on p.6 (55 deg from the film plane); other rows in the atlas may use the film plane. Fig. 4a draws both -3 dB and -6 dB reference lines and the paper does not state whether dB is optical or electrical power; the 1.5 GHz matches the -3 dB line and the fitted linewidths.
